description: This Java source file defines a sample Android service class `SampleVisualQueryDetectionService` that extends `VisualQueryDetectionService`. It handles camera and microphone inputs to detect attention and process audio queries, including methods for starting/stopping detection, handling camera and audio resources, and managing image and audio data streams. The class uses Android Camera2 API and MediaRecorder, indicating its role in processing visual and audio inputs for voice interaction features.

classes.name: SampleVisualQueryDetectionService
classes.description: A sample implementation of a visual query detection service that captures camera frames and audio input, processes them to detect user's attention, and streams a placeholder query string.

methods.name: onStartDetection
methods.description: Initializes background threads for camera and audio, and opens the camera device.

methods.name: onStopDetection
methods.description: Releases all camera and audio resources and stops background threads.

methods.name: onUpdateState
methods.description: Handles updates to the detection service state, currently just logs and reports status.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources upon service destruction.

methods.name: onReceiveImage
methods.description: Processes incoming camera frames, logs the byte data, triggers attention detection, and manages microphone recording.

methods.name: onReceiveAudio
methods.description: Reads audio data from the microphone, logs it, and streams a fake query.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Accesses the camera manager, gets the first available camera, initializes image reader, and opens the camera device.

methods.name: initializeImageReader
methods.description: Sets up an ImageReader for capturing frames from the camera.

methods.name: createCameraPreview
methods.description: Creates a camera capture session with specific configurations and starts preview.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Sets the repeating request to continually capture images based on the configured capture request.

methods.name: openMicrophone
methods.description: Starts audio recording and posts a task to process audio input.

methods.name: releaseResources
methods.description: Cleans up camera and audio resources, closes sessions, and releases objects.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts background threads for camera and audio processing.
